services.name: 3 Hour Sightseeing/Sunset Private Tour
services.desc: 3 -Hour Sightseeing Private Tour​​​ Available June 19th thru October 31st Enjoy a relaxing afternoon on the ocean with the romantic ambiance of Kaua'i's breathtaking sunset. Have your camera ready and keep an eye out for the Nai'a (dolphins) and Honu (sea turtles) as you journey along the west side of Kaua'i's Coastline. Breathe in the gentle sea breeze and take in the incredible, awesome beauty as Captain Kamua and your Hostess share the culture and history of our island home. Watch in delight as they weave lei and partake in other Hawaiian arts and crafts. Relish in the golden hour and sunset as we journey along sharing the catamaran's intimate setting.
